visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: large rounded image, right column (~2/3 width)
visualCharacteristics.structure: stacked white text panels (heading + text) | image
visualCharacteristics.columns: 1/3 panels + 2/3 image on desktop, stacked on mobile

contentPattern: Location info panels beside an image. One row, two cells: cell 1 holds several panels, each starting with a heading (H3 'Parking', 'Metro', 'Taxi') followed by its text; cell 2 holds the image (aerial site map). Section H1, intro and the following full-width text panels are default content in a tinted section.
